desc: Implement an exact integer cube-root bound for \(N\le 10^{18}\).
Enumerate \(d=x-y\) up to \(\lfloor\sqrt[3]{N}\rfloor\), retaining only divisors of \(N\).
Recover \(y\) from the quadratic discriminant using exact integer arithmetic and validate divisibility and positivity.
Verify any candidate directly and handle no-solution cases such as \(N=1\).
Provide the complete Python program with the required stdin/stdout behavior.
